free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the PI-RADS 5 finding, confirmed by the radiology report, meets the EAU guideline threshold for intervention. This decision is strongly supported by the cohort criterion, which matched the reading urologist in all cases with a PI-RADS 3 or higher lesion. The evidence converged on biopsy due to the high-risk imaging finding, which was confirmed by the retrieved radiology report.
